name: pii-shield
description: Masks emails, names, account numbers and secrets on screen while you screen-record. Display only: the model and the transcript keep the real values.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: auto: redact once a screen recorder or screen share is detected (polled every 5s). on: always redact. off: never redact. /redact overrides this for the session.

names.title: Extra names to mask
names.description: Comma-separated names or words to mask (people, clients, projects). Your OS username and git user.name are added automatically.

maskContact.title: Mask emails and phone numbers
maskContact.description: Email addresses, international (+..) and US phone numbers.

maskNetwork.title: Mask IP addresses
maskNetwork.description: IPv4 and IPv6 addresses (loopback and 0.0.0.0 are left alone).

maskFinancial.title: Mask financial numbers
maskFinancial.description: Card numbers (Luhn-checked), IBANs (checksum-checked), US SSNs, bank account, routing and sort codes.

maskSecrets.title: Mask secrets
maskSecrets.description: API keys and tokens, JWTs, Bearer tokens, private key blocks, URL passwords and KEY=value assignments with secret-ish names.

maskNames.title: Mask names
maskNames.description: The extra names above, your OS username and your git user.name.
